_recipe.title: Style: dark gradient AI launch
_recipe.when: Black canvas, glowing gradient type and an orb: the ElevenLabs v3 / Scribe / Framer look for an AI model, API or developer launch.
beats: Orb on black with the version name: light comes out of darkness.
Three short kinetic lines: what it is, what it does, why now.
Demo: a real prompt typed into the product; the result comes back (audio results get a waveform).
Benchmark: real results as bars, your bar in the accent.
One hard number with a meter.
Range: three capabilities as dimming lines.
CTA: one promise, a quiet link; logo.
copyTips: Measured on 26 dark-premium references: 46% are one or two continuous shots and the median shot is 16.7 s. Don't cut often; move inside the frame.
Two accent colours that blend (blue→violet, pink→orange) set as brand.accent and brand.accent2; the theme turns them into the glow and the orb ramp.
Benchmark bars must be real published numbers with their source in the title; never round in your favour.
Say numbers as words in `say`; the screen shows the digits.
Sound: --sfx-pack digital, very low music; the references are nearly silent apart from the product's own audio.
